about:
I am a versatile professional with expertise in software development, DevOps, and project management. 

I specialize in building scalable, reliable, and cloud-ready applications. My experience includes managing Node.js applications (Koa.js, Express.js), implementing CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI, and deploying applications on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) and Google Compute Engine (GCE). 

I also focus on software architecture, code reviews, mentoring team members, and ensuring projects are delivered efficiently
